author: bd-spin/bd-spin-20260513T014512Z-2345176
text:
Closing as the umbrella for the 7-wrapper set was per-wrapper-implemented downstream. 5 of 7 wrappers shipped 2026-05-12 across PKIX-fmtv.11.2 / .12.2 / .13.1 / .13.2; 2 remaining are gated on human-labeled design beads:

| Wrapper | Status | Implementation bead |
|---|---|---|
| verify_tls_server | ✅ shipped | PKIX-fmtv.11.2 |
| verify_tls_client | ⏳ blocked | PKIX-fmtv.11.2.1 (human) — ServerName vs MailboxName shape |
| verify_smime_signer | ✅ shipped | PKIX-fmtv.12.2 |
| verify_smime_recipient | ✅ shipped | PKIX-fmtv.12.2 |
| verify_code_signer | ✅ shipped | PKIX-fmtv.13.1 |
| verify_time_stamper | ✅ shipped | PKIX-fmtv.13.2 |
| verify_ocsp_responder | ⏳ blocked | PKIX-fmtv.13.3 (human) — delegation + nocheck design Qs |

All shipped wrappers follow PKIX-fmtv.7's 5-axis resolution:
- (B1) explicit revocation arg per wrapper
- (C2) generic `<P: Profile>`, baked `DefaultVerifier`
- (D1) pre-parsed `&ServerName<'_>` / `&MailboxName<'_>` identity args (where applicable)
- (E1) `verify_<use_case>` naming

Test surface: 27 integration tests across the 5 shipped wrappers (6 server, 8 smime, 4 codesign, 5 timestamping, 4 unit tests). All fixtures in pkix-chain/tests/fixtures/ generated via pyca/cryptography (P-256, validity 2000-2050).

The bead's original framing ("each wrapper ... returns VerifyReport") is moot per PKIX-fmtv.5's option-A resolution: each wrapper returns `Result<ValidatedPath, Error>` with a small additive `Error::Identity` / `Error::ProfileViolation` variant set.

Closing the umbrella; the two remaining wrappers will ship from their respective beads once the human design questions resolve.
